Hi Karthik,

We're preparing for the pilot integration on Jan 10 and saw SentinelEdge listed as a temporary logging/forensics partner in your subprocessor update. Before we proceed, Legal & InfoSec need the following:

- A short description of the processing SentinelEdge will perform and confirmation they only handle logs (no customer content).
- ISO/SOC attestation summary (or equivalent).
- Data flow diagram showing what leaves FinTrust network and what is stored by SentinelEdge.
- Retention policy and deletion process for logs containing PII.
- Contractual safeguards (DPA addendum or subprocessor clause).

Can you confirm whether SentinelEdge will have cross-border access, and if so, whether there is an onshore fallback option? We need these items no later than Dec 31 to complete our pre-prod approvals.

Thanks,
Anna Ruiz
Senior Security Counsel
FinTrust Bank

- Purpose: SentinelEdge will only ingest application logs for debugging/forensics tied to the pilot; they will not receive or index customer content (LLM prompts/responses) by design.

We will assemble the SOC/attestation summary and a dataflow snapshot. Kimberly — can you confirm the minimal contractual language we should provide as a DPA addendum for a temporary processor? Marissa — FYI for the pilot timeline and sales commitments.

I'll aim to get a first packet to you by Dec 29 EOD.

Thanks — quick internal note (checklist for the packet we'll send to FinTrust):

1) Vendor scope statement: brief paragraph limiting processing to "application logs for debugging and incident forensics"; expressly exclude "model prompts, model outputs, and customer-managed data."
2) Attestation summary: SentinelEdge SOC2 Type II summary or equivalent; if full SOC2 not available, request their latest third-party security assessment and a timezone-stamped snapshot of controls.
3) Dataflow diagram: show ingress, storage, retention period (max 30 days for pilot), and deletion trigger/process.
4) Access controls: role-based access, MFA, just-in-time access logs, and least-privilege admin policy.
5) Onshore-only routing: concrete config (Lauren) and proof-of-routing (test endpoint or diagram).
6) DPA addendum language: temporary processor clause, limited retention, breach notification window (48 hours), audit rights and export controls.
7) Evidence proof: we should provide at least one audit artifact (encrypted snapshot of config, sanitized log sample) and a contact at SentinelEdge for legal.

Lauren — if onshore-only routing is non-trivial, propose a fallback plan (canary window + read-only access for sentinel). Marissa — we'll want to coordinate a short note for FinTrust's procurement asking them to sign the addendum quickly (link to DocuSign).

I'll draft the DPA addendum template and the evidence checklist.

Kimberly Park
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

Anna — thank you and apologies for the delivery delay. Attached is a concise evidence packet and the next steps. Summary below and attachments at the bottom.

Brief summary (pilot scope):
- SentinelEdge will only collect application telemetry/logs for the three-week pilot environment used by FinTrust. They will not collect LLM prompts/responses or persist customer content.
- Retention for pilot logs: default 14 days; can be configured to 7 days for FinTrust. Logs with suspected PII will be redacted on ingestion where possible; deletion API available.
- Processing location: US-only routing for FinTrust during the pilot (EU node disabled).

Evidence provided (attachments):
- sentinelledge-soc2-summary.pdf: vendor-provided SOC2 summary and control highlights.
- redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx: checklist mapping each of FinTrust's asks to artifacts and where they live.

Key contractual points we propose in the DPA addendum: temporary processor scope (end date + automatic revocation), 48-hour breach notification, audit rights limited to redacted config-level artifacts, and onshore routing requirement for FinTrust. Kimberly will share the proposed clause text next.

Next steps and timeline:
1) FinTrust OK on scope and retention? Reply with any redline by Dec 31.
2) If accepted, we'll send a DocuSign DPA addendum for signature by Jan 3.
3) Lauren to perform routing test and share a short screenshot/proof by Jan 4.
4) SentinelEdge contact for technical follow-up: Brian Holt (brian.holt@sentinelledge.com).

If you want, we can also stand up a 30-minute call Thursday (Dec 30) with FinTrust InfoSec and SentinelEdge to walk the flow.

Regards,
